title: Get Down Fishing Charters

services.name: Tuna Fishing
services.desc: We believe we are one of the finest Snapper Fishing Charters in the Cocoa Beach, Florida area. In fact, if we had a forte', this would be it! Anglers love fishing for Snapper because they fight hard and are delicious to eat. On this fishing trip you and your group will target reef fish hanging around natural and artificial structure. We offer Cocoa Beach fishing charters for Mangrove, Lane, Vermillion Snapper & Red Snapper. This is an excellent fishing trip for families with smaller children. Call Get Down Charters today to bag some delicious Snapper on your next Port Canaveral Sportfishing Adventure! We also catch several other different types of species when Bottom fishing off the coast

explain.meaning: A trip of about six hours.
A long trip, usually around eight hours.

blurb: Guests spend the day fishing aboard a 32' Prowler charter boat from Port Canaveral near Cocoa Beach on Florida's Space Coast. The charters offer access to deep sea sport fishing on Florida's East Central Atlantic coast. The boat is Coast Guard licensed and accommodates groups up to 6.
